skill.name: set-up-shopify-google-ads-poas-bidding
skill.description: Set up profit-based bidding for Shopify in Google Ads with Product Metrics. Check tracking and costs, compare profit and revenue conversion actions, and choose an initial target. The account operator makes the bidding changes in Google Ads.
skill.summary: Use Shopify order profit to guide Google Ads bidding with Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance alerts and most command and URL alerts describe routine setup, read-only checks, or documentation. Confirmed risks include order data access without explicit minimization, a remote tool connection, and an unpinned installer. Additional concerns include unvalidated browser handoffs, raw credential guidance, and setup steps that exceed the Google Ads scope.

remediation.issue: Order checks request order-level records without explicit minimization.
remediation.suggestion: Verify the workspace, store, and test order before querying. Return only the revenue, profit, and tracking status needed for the check.

remediation.issue: The fallback directs agents to a remote MCP service without requiring confirmation of the connection.
remediation.suggestion: Use only an approved Product Metrics connection. Confirm the workspace and data scope before sending merchant data or making changes.

remediation.issue: The installation command leaves the installer and skill source revision unpinned.
remediation.suggestion: Document installation with a pinned installer version and an immutable, reviewed source revision. Require user approval before executing the installer.

remediation.issue: Browser URLs returned by tools are handed to the user without a stated destination check.
remediation.suggestion: Require HTTPS and verify the expected provider and destination before presenting a URL. Tell the user what account and action to expect.

remediation.issue: Shared rules permit unrelated channels to pass raw credentials through agent commands.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the unrelated exceptions. Direct users to provider sign-in or an approved secret entry flow that keeps credentials out of chats and command logs.

remediation.issue: The fallback checklist can expand tracking beyond the requested Google Ads account.
remediation.suggestion: Limit setup to the approved Shopify store and Google Ads client account. Require separate authorization before adding other destinations or customer data features.

content.user_title: Set Up Profit Bidding for Shopify in Google Ads
content.value_statement: A Shopify campaign can meet its revenue target and still lose money after costs. Use Product Metrics to verify profit tracking and plan a Google Ads bidding switch.
actual_capabilities: Read setup status through the Product Metrics CLI or MCP and identify unfinished steps.
Guide the setup of Shopify, Google Ads, and Merchant Center connections.
Explain how product costs, payment fees, and other configured costs affect the profit signal.
Check whether a test order arrived with revenue and profit and identify missing cost data.
Suggest an initial target ROAS from observed campaign POAS and verify the conversion action after the operator changes it.
limitations: Live checks require authorized Product Metrics access, and Shopify tracking requires an active app subscription.
The account operator must change the primary conversion action and bidding settings in Google Ads.
Missing costs can leave an order without a profit value. Loss-making orders are sent with zero profit.
The skill does not set up new customer, returning customer, or lifetime value bidding.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Missing Profit Values
use_cases.description: Find out why a Shopify test order has revenue but no profit before relying on profit-based bids.

use_cases.title: Pilot Profit-Based Bidding
use_cases.description: Choose an initial target from observed POAS and plan a switch for one campaign.

use_cases.title: Verify a Client Conversion Setup
use_cases.description: Check the Shopify and Google Ads connections, consent settings, and primary purchase action for the approved client account.

prompt_templates.title: Check the Prerequisites
prompt_templates.prompt: List what I need before using Shopify profit for Google Ads bidding. Separate Product Metrics setup from changes I must make in Google Ads.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Test Order
prompt_templates.prompt: My Shopify test order has revenue but no profit. Explain which cost settings to check and what I should see when tracking works.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Campaign Pilot
prompt_templates.prompt: One campaign has an observed POAS of 1.5. Suggest an initial target ROAS for profit bidding and explain what I should verify before switching.
prompt_templates.scenario: Switch from revenue bidding to profit bidding

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Completed Switch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my approved Product Metrics connection to check the selected Google Ads client account. Verify which purchase action is primary and whether the campaign uses a campaign-specific goal. Report what you cannot confirm and do not change anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Read-only verification after a manual change

output_examples.input: A Shopify test order arrived with revenue but no profit. What should I check?
output: Check the variant cost in Shopify, the matching SKU cost in Merchant Center, and the configured Product cost fallback.
Confirm that additional costs are active, then run a tracking test with a new test order.

output_examples.input: My campaign has a measured POAS of 1.5. What target should I try?
output: Use 150% as an initial target ROAS on the profit conversion. Do not reuse the revenue-based target.
Start with one campaign and reassess after a few weeks.

best_practices: Confirm consent and cost settings, then verify profit on a test order before switching bidding.
Pilot one campaign and set the initial target using its observed POAS.
Keep only one purchase action primary for the campaign and verify the setting after the switch.
anti_patterns: Reuse a revenue-based target after switching the campaign to profit-based bidding.
Make both revenue and profit purchase actions primary for the same campaign.
Switch bidding before checking whether the order feed contains usable profit values.

faq.question: What is the difference between POAS and ROAS?
faq.answer: POAS compares tracked profit before ad costs with ad spend. ROAS compares revenue with ad spend.

faq.question: Why does Google Ads still call the setting target ROAS?
faq.answer: Google Ads uses the same setting for any conversion value. When the campaign uses profit as its value, the percentage targets profit relative to ad spend.

faq.question: Do I need Merchant Center?
faq.answer: Yes. Link Merchant Center to the Google Ads client account that runs your campaigns, then connect it in Product Metrics.

faq.question: Why is a paid order missing a profit value?
faq.answer: If a required cost is unknown, Product Metrics sends revenue without profit. Review Shopify costs and the additional cost settings.

faq.question: Should I delete the old purchase conversion?
faq.answer: No. Keep it as secondary, or use a campaign-specific goal so the campaign bids on one purchase action.

faq.question: What happens when Shopify reports a refund?
faq.answer: Product Metrics adjusts the order conversion it sent to Google Ads.
